messages:
claire: short RFC follow-up: propose a tiny preempt handshake so frontdoor can enforce stream SLOs without surprisal for SDKs/runtimes.

noah: sketch the handshake?

claire: flow: client sends x-rd-fence; frontdoor responds with attempt-id + shed-score header; when approaching budget it emits a PREEMPT trailer with metadata (reason, resume-window-ms, checkpoint-ref optional).

felix: important to distinguish PREEMPT vs ABORT. PREEMPT = we politely ask runtime to checkpoint and close; ABORT = hard kill. different billing/observability semantics.

anya: agree. also need resume-capable boolean so SDK knows whether to try reconnecting with same fence. header set at accept time.

claire: suggested headers:
```
x-rd-fence: <uuid>|<kid>|<hmac>
x-rd-accept-attempt: 42
x-rd-shed-score: 65
x-rd-resume-capable: 1
```
trailer on preempt:
```
x-rd-preempt: reason=egress_pressure;resume-window-ms=3000;checkpoint=kv:abc123;attempt=42
```

noah: resume-window-ms determines KV retention cost. route-level default should be conservative (2-3s) and tunable.

felix: resume correctness: runtime must emit a resume-checksum with checkpoint so resumed attempt can verify continuity and SDK can suppress duplicate tokens billing. e.g. x-rd-checksum: sha256=...

anya: security: fence must be tenant-scoped and HMACed; runtime must validate kid+hmac. also avoid leaking checkpoint refs across tenants.

claire: billing proposal: charge emitted tokens per attempt. if resume-checksum matches and SDK suppresses duplicates we prorate earlier attempt (refund of re-emitted portion) or mark as resumed so only new tokens billed. include small preempt credit to discourage abuse.

noah: observability: emit span tags for fence.id, attempt.id, branch.id; metrics: preempt_signals, resume_attempts, resume_successes, preempt_refunds, duplicate_token_count. link traces across attempts using branch id.

felix: fallback behavior: if runtime declares NON_RESUMABLE in response to preempt (e.g., disk pressure), frontdoor can either hard-reject or automatically try a fallback variant (cheaper model) depending on route policy. fallback must preserve fence lineage so client sees a coherent stream header like "[switched to fallback]". SDK can choose to auto-accept or surface choice.

anya: edge policy knobs: admission=soft|hard; resume_window_ms; fallback_policy=none|auto|prompt; preempt_penalty_ms (billing).

claire: small spike plan:
- frontdoor: accept fence header, return accept-attempt, compute shed-score, send preempt trailer, record metrics
- runtime stub: support receiving preempt trailer and returning checkpoint + checksum or NON_RESUMABLE
- SDK demo: subscribe to preempt events and implement auto-resume with same fence behind a feature flag

ops-bot: canary branch rd/preempt-grace-spike created; assign owners and run infra checklist.

noah: I'll take frontdoor spike. felix -> runtime stub. anya -> SDK demo. reconvene next week with numbers on KV retention vs duplicate compute.

claire: thanks all. let's be careful with header naming and put this follow-up into the RFC doc as an appendix. :thumbsup:
